pages.title: Lazy Labs: Formbell for Google Forms and Pollfold for Shopify
pages.description: Lazy Labs makes small, focused software. With Formbell, you can email the right person when a Google Forms answer matches a rule. With Pollfold, you can run post-purchase surveys across Shopify stores.

pages.title: Formbell: Conditional email notifications for Google Forms
pages.description: With Formbell, a Google Forms add-on by Lazy Labs, you can automatically email the right person when an answer matches your rule. On Free you run one rule at a time across your Google account. Pro is $4 a month or $29 a year.
